programs.title: Best Of 70s – The Golden Era
programs.desc: Step into Bollywood's most soulful decade with this jukebox of evergreen melodies. A rich tapestry of romance, innocence, and timeless charm – pure nostalgia from the golden 70s.

programs.title: Best Of 90s – Filmy Beats Reloaded
programs.desc: Take a ride through the vibrant 90s with peppy love anthems, dramatic duets, and emotional melodies. This jukebox celebrates the signature style of Bollywood's musical revival decade.

programs.title: Rajesh Khanna – The Superstar's Anthems
programs.desc: Revisit the unmatched charm of Rajesh Khanna with this jukebox of unforgettable melodies. Romantic, philosophical, and heartfelt – these songs defined an era and a superstar.

programs.title: Jeetendra Hits The Jumping Jack
programs.desc: Dive into Jeetendra's iconic hits—The Jumping Jack's timeless energy! Relive the magic of Bollywood's golden era with foot-tapping beats, romance, and pure nostalgia!

programs.title: Neetu Singh Evergreen Hits
programs.desc: Turn up the retro vibes with Neetu Singh's greatest hits! A birthday playlist packed with nostalgia, romance, and endless charm.
